messages.author: a41d59653cf478f8
messages.subject: Rotating a Huge phylogenetic tree
parts:
Hi, I am trying to rotate node 1099996 in my phylogenetic tree of ~100k tips. But, after twelve hours my Rstudio did not show the result.
Any idea to solve this problem?

This is the command that I am using:
p1_rotated<-ggtree::rotate(plot_tree,node=109996)

Thank you very much in advance,

Santiago Justo
